title: Ram das aka Chhota Bruce Lee
description: Bruce Lee is everywhere in Ram Das’s home. One oversized poster shows the martial arts legend in his iconic pose. Right beside it hangs another. Of Ram Das himself, dressed, styled and standing just like his hero.
